task: Assess whether the dependency source configuration permits an attacker package to replace the intended private package.
facts: acme-build-tools is intended to come only from the private index.
The private index has version 1.4.0, while an attacker can publish the same unreserved name and version 99.0.0 to the public index.
The installation command uses the public index plus the private index as --extra-index-url without hashes or an enforced source binding.
